name: The Dog House Megaways

features.name: Multiplier wilds
features.description: Wilds carry 1x–3x multipliers which multiply together when they combine on a win.

features.name: Choice of free spins
features.description: Pick sticky wilds (fewer spins, wilds stay) or raining wilds (more spins, new wilds each spin).

review: The Dog House Megaways takes the original Dog House sticky-wild bonus and puts it on BTG's Megaways engine. The highlight is the free spins choice: sticky wilds are the classic high-risk option, while raining wilds tends to pay more consistently. Wild multipliers multiply each other, so two or three wilds on one win can produce surprisingly large results.
pros: Choice of two distinct bonus types
cons: Megaways base game can be quiet
